checks.name: positive-prompts
checks.detail: Ten package/protocol/workflow/extension tests passed. The fixed Blender 5.2.1 admission probe authored a pose action and reproduced its semantic digest after independent reopen. The native canary validated and built extension 0.3.0, compatibly replaced a 10-channel/20-key pose action, matched semantic digest sha256:d88ebb2357737f36b346724b1c38176296207bcb4a00ed8e79978ecb75d768d1, parsed enabled and stripped GLBs, and produced verified viewport, render, GLB, and USD artifacts before exact rollback.

checks.name: negative-prompts
checks.detail: Protocol, workflow, and native-canary checks rejected execute_python, unknown action/RNA-shaped fields, invalid legacy keyframe properties and indices, duplicate/out-of-range pose keys, non-unit quaternions, non-positive scale, oversized numeric payloads, missing bones, foreign action bindings, non-GLB extras, unauthenticated loopback access, and cross-project queue reads.

checks.name: missing-context
checks.detail: A harmless direct inspect_project call without projectFile returned status rejected and isError=true with `projectFile must be absolute`; it dispatched no native operation and caused no project mutation.

checks.name: failure-prompts
checks.detail: Tests and code-path inspection fail closed for stale revision, dirty state, forbidden or unknown fields, invalid pose semantics, incompatible replacement, path violations, missing ownership, invalid receipts, artifact hash mismatch, semantic/native readback mismatch, and uncertain restoration; recovery preserves manual-recovery-required.
